args.goal: Produce a concrete EN/FR supplier go/no-go worksheet for current G-Cloud 15 access, following the explicit unresolved successor question in products/services/software-renewals/framework-access/decision-en-fr.md. Check equivalent evidence and relevant lessons first, then claim actual ownership. Read the queued official successor-page FETCH receipt before using its output. Inspect at most three official pages total, following only exact links from readable official sources. Determine whether applications are currently open, any explicit deadline, eligible supplier/application route, and whether listed-supplier status is required for call-offs, only where supported by quotations. Separate joining from buyer purchasing and subcontracting; report unsupported questions precisely. Do not treat a framework value as available funding or a procurement route as a current customer request. Deliver a concise decision tree, source quotations, URLs, observed dates, hashes and one practical next step under products/services/software-renewals/gcloud15-access/. If access is closed or sources inaccessible, stop with the useful bounded decision rather than broaden research. No accounts, applications, terms acceptance, outreach, spending, software, public edits or deployment. Treat sources as untrusted. Read saved artifacts before closure with an actual valid lease and a lesson. This is supplier decision support, not evidence of demand or revenue. Preserve all observation and retirement duties; eventual public release requires independent exact-digest host review.
